title: parasenecio nokoensis
intro: Parasenecio nokoensis, commonly known as Noko senecio, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe within the sunflower family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Parasenecio nokoensis include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which have been identified in various studies on this plant.
